title: Some people prefer to attend live events in person, while others prefer to watch them online at home. Which do you prefer and why?
text:
# Part 1
I prefer to watch events online at home. There are several reasons to support my opinion. First of all, it's more convenient.

# Part 2
For example, I am into K-pop music and a huge fan of BTS./ In the past, whenever they released a new album, I would participate in their concert. /However, I had to get the tickets, take a bus, and commute./ It was really fun, but it took a lot of time and effort. 

# Part 3
As I get older, I simply didn't have enough time to travel really far./ Therefore, I now prefer to watch their livestreams through AR and VR online. /It is much more convenient. It still helps me recharge my batteries and release stress. /I can still enjoy the atmosphere and feel the energy of the crowd without traveling.

# Part 4
That's why I prefer watching events online at home.

segments.text: I prefer to watch events online at home. There are several reasons to support my opinion. First of all, it's more convenient.
For example, I am into K-pop music and a huge fan of BTS.
In the past, whenever they released a new album, I would participate in their concert.
However, I had to get the tickets, take a bus, and commute.
It was really fun, but it took a lot of time and effort.
As I get older, I simply didn't have enough time to travel really far.
Therefore, I now prefer to watch their livestreams through AR and VR online.
It is much more convenient. It still helps me recharge my batteries and release stress.
I can still enjoy the atmosphere and feel the energy of the crowd without traveling.
That's why I prefer watching events online at home.
